description: Raw-stream fx2/cmix sidecar ablation with exactly one schema context family: template hash plus template argument coordinate plus slot. No inline transform, no page reorder, no hard masks.
deps: C++ runtime for bundled cmix/fx2 binary
hypothesis: Same-template, same-argument-coordinate bytes are better predicted than the base model alone, while keeping the raw enwik9 byte stream continuous and decoder-recomputable.
